comparison.notes: SE differs (11.5%) but CI overlap - methodological difference

run_metadata.thread_policy: No arm is thread-restricted: R runs at fixest/data.table defaults; diff-diff wheels run at Accelerate/rayon defaults. Thread-count env vars (RAYON/OMP/OPENBLAS/VECLIB/MKL/data.table) are stripped from every benchmark subprocess and R runs under --vanilla (no user/site .Rprofile/.Renviron), so package defaults are enforced, not assumed. Per-arm thread counts are recorded in each result's metadata.
run_metadata.protocol: Each replication is a fresh subprocess run strictly sequentially (one benchmark process on the machine at a time) with an untimed in-process warm-up fit before the timed fit. The first replication is additionally excluded from statistics. Published statistic: median of the counted replications. Arms with CV > 10% are rerun once and flagged if still noisy.
